description: Compile-time budgets: the targets NFR-03, NFR-04 and NFR-05 of plan §3.2, as the plan states them, relative to the hand-written wiring.

Every target compares a variant with the baseline variant built by the same compiler in the same run (plan §3.2 and §8.4), so that the machine's speed cancels out. Each compiler is checked on its own, as the plan quotes GCC and Clang separately, and a graph budget applies to every generated graph profile (fan-in and request forms) that is measured at the listed size.
compile_s is the median wall time of the compiles (median of 3, plan §8.4); peak_rss_mb is the compiler's peak resident memory.

max_extra: the variant may take at most this much more than the baseline (NFR-03 is a difference, not a ratio). checkpoints: at each listed N, the variant may take at most max_ratio times the baseline.
growth and layouts restate the plan's conditions that are not a single number; benchmarks/compile/run.py does not check them.
benchmarks/compile/run.py reads this file. Changing it needs the owner's sign-off: propose the change in docs/PROGRESS.md.
